<thought>From the measurements we can see that all nodes lie on a single series path from A to B. The incremental resistances between consecutive nodes match the measured pairwise resistances, confirming a linear chain. The resistor values are:
R1 = 5 Ω (A‑N_a1)
R2 = 10 Ω (N_a1‑N_a2)
R3 = 15 Ω (N_a2‑N_a3)
R4 = 20 Ω (N_a3‑X1)
R5 = 10 Ω (X1‑N_b1)
R6 = 15 Ω (N_b1‑N_b2)
R7 = 20 Ω (N_b2‑X2)
R8 = 10 Ω (X2‑N_c1)
R9 = 15 Ω (N_c1‑N_c2)
R10 = 20 Ω (N_c2‑B)

Thus the circuit topology is a simple series chain connecting the nodes in that order.</thought>
